commands: docker compose -p tb-dos-thingsboard-static-0001 run --rm -e INSTALL_TB=true -e LOAD_DEMO=false -e JAVA_OPTS='-Xms512m -Xmx1024m -Xss384k' tb-node
config_changes: Mapped HTTP port 8080 to localhost:18080 for isolation.
Set TB_SERVICE_TYPE=monolith and TB_QUEUE_TYPE=in-memory, matching image defaults used for single-node deployment.
Strict retest harness capped target JVM with -Xms512m -Xmx1024m and container memory with mem_limit=2g.
Removed non-HTTP host port mappings after an unrelated MQTT port collision; validated entry used HTTP only.

reachability.account_used: No valid device token was required for the reinforced OOM observation; the token-shaped path segment returned HTTP 401 for smaller bodies but the 512MiB body failed during handler dispatch with Java heap OOM.

steps: Started official tb-node single-node deployment with PostgreSQL.
Sent telemetry requests with an arbitrary token-shaped path segment. A separate attempt to create a fresh disposable device after OOM was not needed for the confirmed trigger.

trigger.request_shape: HTTP/1.1 POST /api/v1/{deviceToken}/telemetry with Transfer-Encoding: chunked, Content-Type: application/json, no Content-Length, and a JSON object shaped as {"ts":1,"values":{"k":"<large string>"}}.
trigger.loop_variable: body byte volume in one JSON string value
trigger.bandwidth_notes: Single external HTTP client, sequential chunked requests. The 512MiB telemetry body returned HTTP 500 with an OutOfMemoryError message under -Xmx1024m.

baseline.docker_stats_before_telemetry_256m: MemUsage=1.672GiB/2GiB, /login status=200 after prior attributes reinforcement probe

peak.telemetry_512m_response: HTTP 500 {"message":"Handler dispatch failed: java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space"}
peak.heap_dump: runtime/tb-logs/java_pid1.hprof was created at 723M and deleted after recording size
peak.post_oom_availability: /login remained HTTP 200; this is externally triggered target-JVM OOME rather than full process death

utilization_conditions.summary: 官方 ThingsBoard tb-node 单节点部署中，HTTP device telemetry path 会在认证结果返回前读取并绑定 chunked JSON body；在 -Xmx1024m / 2g 容器补测下，单个 512MiB timeseries-large-value telemetry 请求触发目标 JVM `OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space` 并返回 HTTP 500。
limits_or_mitigations: Reverse proxy, servlet container, or Spring request limits that reject chunked/no-Content-Length bodies before controller binding mitigate this path.
A lower ThingsBoard HTTP transport max payload enforced independently of Content-Length would mitigate this path.
JSON string length/body complexity limits before @RequestBody String materialization would mitigate this path.
Authentication alone is insufficient if request body binding precedes token rejection for this endpoint shape.
not_affected_when: HTTP device transport is not exposed to low-trust clients.
Chunked request bodies without Content-Length are rejected or capped before Spring binds @RequestBody String.
Telemetry JSON body size/string length is bounded before JsonParser.parseString and JsonConverter processing.

safety.heap_or_container_limit: ThingsBoard tb-node JAVA_OPTS=-Xms512m -Xmx1024m -Xss384k; Docker compose mem_limit=2g

static_traceability.source: Device HTTP transport POST bodies under /api/v1/{deviceToken}/telemetry and /api/v1/{deviceToken}/attributes.
static_traceability.sink: Spring @RequestBody String followed by JsonParser.parseString and JsonConverter conversion in DeviceApiController.
static_traceability.driver: Body byte volume and JSON key/value or timestamp-array count; especially requests without a positive Content-Length.
missing_static_evidence: Whether embedded servlet container or upstream proxy rejects chunked bodies above configured limits by default.
Whether Spring/Tomcat request body buffering imposes an independent cap for no Content-Length requests.

notes: 2026-06-30 reinforcement raised the ThingsBoard target JVM to -Xmx1024m and container memory to 2g.

The confirmed TB-APP-STATIC-0001 telemetry request used a 512MiB chunked timeseries-large-value JSON body and returned HTTP 500 with `Handler dispatch failed: java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space`.

The reused token-shaped path segment returned HTTP 401 for smaller requests, so the strengthened exploitability statement is anonymous body-binding-before-auth OOM rather than successful device-token telemetry ingestion.
